Abstract. The Employee Handbook introduces Nexora Technologies, its values and organisation structure, and explains the
terms of employment, working hours, code of conduct, performance review cycle, disciplinary process and exit procedure. It
is the primary reference for new joiners and is supplemented by the Leave Policy, Benefits Guide, Expense Policy and
Coding Standards. Employee grades G1 to G6 defined here are used across all other policies.
Keywords: employee handbook, grades, probation, notice period, performance review, disciplinary process, code of
conduct
1. About Nexora Technologies
Nexora Technologies (Pvt.) Ltd. is a software company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Gulberg III,
Lahore, with offices in Karachi and Islamabad. Nexora builds AI-powered customer-support and
workflow-automation software (NexaDesk, NexaFlow and NexaInsight) used by over 1,200 business customers.
The company employs approximately 450 people; Figure 1 shows the distribution by department.
1.1 Company Values
• Integrity - we are honest with customers, colleagues and regulators.
• Ownership - we take responsibility for outcomes, not only tasks.
• Craft - we care about the quality of what we build and how we build it.
• Collaboration - we share knowledge and succeed as teams.

3.2 Probation, Confirmation and Notice
New employees serve a probation period of 3 months, which may be extended once by up to 3 months.
Confirmation is issued in writing after a satisfactory review by the line manager and HR. During probation either
party may end employment with 7 days' notice. After confirmation, the notice period is 1 month for grades G1 to
G3 and 2 months for grades G4 to G6. Notice can be waived or shortened only by the department head and
Head of HR.
4. Working Hours and Attendance
Nexora is an office-based company. Employees are expected to work from their assigned office; remote work is
allowed only with written approval of the department head and for a defined period.

5. Code of Conduct
• Treat colleagues, customers and vendors with respect. Harassment, discrimination and bullying are not
tolerated.
• Dress code: business casual from Monday to Thursday; smart casual on Friday. Client-facing staff follow
business formal for meetings.
• Declare any conflict of interest (for example a family member working for a vendor) to HR in writing.
• Do not accept gifts from vendors worth more than PKR 5,000; report offers above that limit to Finance.
• Protect customer data. Company laptops must use disk encryption, and customer data must never be
copied to personal devices or personal cloud storage.
• Use approved AI tools only. Do not paste source code, customer data or credentials into public AI services.
6. Performance Management
Nexora runs an annual performance cycle with a mid-year review (Figure 3). Goals are written as 3 to 5
measurable objectives agreed between the employee and line manager. Ratings are calibrated across
departments by a committee chaired by the CEO to keep standards consistent.

7. Disciplinary Process
Nexora follows a progressive disciplinary approach for misconduct that is not serious enough to justify
immediate termination. Gross misconduct (fraud, harassment, theft, serious data breach) may lead to immediate
termination after an inquiry.
Table 4. Progressive disciplinary steps.
Step
Action
Validity
1
Verbal warning recorded by line manager and HR
6 months
2
Written warning placed on the personnel file
12 months
3
Final written warning; may include suspension without pay for up to 3 days
12 months
4
Termination after inquiry by a committee of HR and a department head not in the
employee's reporting line
-
8. Grievances and Workplace Harassment
Employees may raise concerns with their line manager, the HR business partner or, where the concern involves
either, directly with the Head of HR. Complaints of harassment are handled by the Inquiry Committee
constituted under the Protection against Harassment of Women at the Workplace Act, 2010; a complaint may be
filed in writing or by email to the committee, and the committee completes its inquiry within 30 days. Retaliation
against a complainant is itself gross misconduct.
9. Exit Procedure
On resignation the employee submits a written notice to the line manager and HR. A knowledge-transfer plan is
agreed within the first week of the notice period. On the last working day the employee returns laptops, access
cards and other assets; IT revokes all access by 6:00 PM. Final settlement (salary, leave encashment, provident
fund and gratuity as per the Benefits Guide) is paid within 30 days of the last working day, after clearance from
IT, Finance and HR.
